text:
You're not stuck. You're pulling from the wrong source.

3 places to find real answers:

1. Your gut. The signal that fires before you think.
2. What men before you figured out. Books. Real experience.
3. Your own test. What works for YOUR life right now.

Most men live the copy life. They grab someone else's answer and wonder why it doesn't fit.

When you're stuck, go in order: gut, then books, then test.

Copy a life. Live nothing. Build a source. Live yours.
caption:
Self improvement stalls when men run the copy life. Mindset and discipline need the right source. Success habits are built on knowing where your answers come from.

Send this to a man who needs it today.
